feature.title: Tubeless Insulin Pumps, AI Echocardiography, and Robotic Surgery Milestones Headline a Landmark Week in MedTech
feature.summary: The week of November 17–22, 2026 delivered a cluster of concrete implementation results across medtech: the FDA cleared two competing tubeless automated insulin delivery systems in quick succession, while a landmark Kaiser Permanente trial presented at AHA Scientific Sessions proved AI can halve cardiologist review time for echocardiograms without sacrificing accuracy. Robotics programs at institutions from Saudi Arabia to USC posted real-world outcome data, and a new wave of FDA-cleared diagnostics — from smartphone-based tremor monitoring to automated stroke screening — moved from bench to bedside. Underlying all of it is a measurable acceleration in the pace of AI integration directly into clinical workflows, with Mayo Clinic's live EHR rollout and Fujitsu's AI-screened oncology trial standing as the week's most consequential deployment stories.

highlights.label: Biggest story
highlights.text: MiniMed Fit received FDA clearance as the world's first tubeless insulin pump with 7-day wear and 300-unit capacity, entering a market now contested by three competitors for the first time.

highlights.label: Key trend
highlights.text: AI is proving its clinical ROI in cardiology: a 1,200-patient randomized trial showed AI-drafted echocardiogram reports cut cardiologist reading time 46% with equivalent accuracy to human sonographers.

highlights.label: To watch
highlights.text: King Faisal Specialist Hospital's disclosure today of 118% robotic surgery growth and a 98% cardiac survival rate across 400 procedures signals that the global robotics rollout is now generating hard outcome benchmarks.

articles.title: FDA Clears MiniMed Fit™ — World's First Tubeless Insulin Pump with Up to Seven-Day Wear and Zero Interruptions
articles.snippet: MiniMed received FDA 510(k) clearance on November 16, 2026 for its first tubeless insulin pump, the MiniMed Fit, cleared for patients aged 7 and older with Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes. The device offers up to twice the wear time and 50% more insulin capacity (300 units) than competing tubeless pumps, with SmartGuard automated insulin delivery adjusting dosing every five minutes via a smartphone app.
articles.result: 7-day wear, 300-unit capacity; 2× wear time vs. rivals

articles.title: AI Cuts Cardiologists' Echocardiogram Review Time by 46% in 1,200-Patient Kaiser Permanente Trial
articles.source: NewMediaWire / American Heart Association Scientific Sessions 2026
articles.snippet: Late-breaking research presented at AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 in Chicago showed that AI-drafted preliminary echocardiogram interpretations were statistically equivalent in accuracy to those produced by sonographers and cardiologists across 21 Kaiser Permanente centers in Northern California. Cardiologists spent an average of 4.6 minutes finalizing AI-generated reports versus 8.5 minutes without AI assistance — a 46% time reduction — and could not reliably distinguish AI-generated reports from human ones.
articles.result: Review time cut from 8.5 to 4.6 min (46%) across 1,200 scans

articles.title: King Faisal Specialist Hospital Reports 118% Robotic Surgery Growth, 98% Cardiac Survival Rate Across 400 Procedures
articles.snippet: King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre in Riyadh disclosed today that robotic surgery volumes grew 118% over three years, rising from 771 procedures in 2022 to 1,685 in 2025, with a further 23% year-on-year jump. The cardiac robotic surgery program achieved a 98% patient survival rate across 400 procedures since launch, and 96% of kidney donors were discharged within 24 hours, with the hospital also performing three world-first procedures including a fully robotic heart transplant.
articles.result: 98% cardiac survival rate; 96% of kidney donors home within 24 hrs

articles.title: Masimo smartSedLine Receives FDA Clearance with Faster Brain Activity Readings Under Anesthesia
articles.source: Medical Device Network / Orange County Business Journal
articles.snippet: Masimo, a Danaher company, received its seventh FDA 510(k) clearance of 2026 on November 18 for smartSedLine, a next-generation brain function monitoring system for use during anesthesia. The updated PSi algorithm delivers faster induction response readings and maintains stability under low-power EEG conditions, enabling clinicians to optimize sedation depth from induction through the entire intraoperative period.
articles.result: Faster PSi induction response; stable under low-power EEG — 7th FDA clearance of 2026

articles.title: Implantica RefluxStop® First U.S. Procedures Completed at USC; Real-World 602-Patient Data Matches PMA Trial
articles.snippet: Implantica completed the first U.S. commercial RefluxStop® procedures at the University of Southern California on November 4, 2026, following FDA PMA approval in August. Real-world safety data from 602 patients across 22 European centers matched the controlled trial results, and in the FDA PMA study zero patients failed objective 24-hour pH testing versus a 36% failure rate for the leading competitor in its own FDA trial.
articles.result: 0% pH test failure vs. 36% for leading competitor; 602-patient real-world data match

articles.title: Fujitsu & Paradigm AI Screens 22,334 Lung Cancer Patients, Identifies 57 Trial Candidates with 89% Physician Confirmation
articles.snippet: Fujitsu Japan, the National Cancer Center Hospital East and Paradigm Health completed a verification study covering 22,334 respiratory medicine patients, using an LLM to structure EMR data and match it against five eligibility criteria for a simulated EGFR-mutation trial. From 540 EGFR-positive patients, the AI selected 57 priority candidates, of which physician review confirmed 51 (89%) as genuinely promising — without manual record searches.

articles.title: Mayo Clinic Platform Launches AI Clinical Decision Support Natively Inside EHR Workflows for 35+ Specialties
articles.snippet: Mayo Clinic Platform deployed its AI-enabled Clinical Decision Support solution in November 2026, embedding a specialty-specific LLM chat covering more than 35 specialties and 22 clinical calculators directly inside EHR environments, available to Mayo clinicians and partner health systems. The tool is updated daily with peer-reviewed evidence and is accessible via chat or voice dictation, reducing the need for clinicians to navigate multiple separate resources during patient consultations.
articles.result: Live EHR deployment across 35+ specialties and partner health systems Nov. 2026

articles.title: Sine Health Wins FDA Clearance for World's First Smartphone-Only Essential Tremor Monitor, Covering 7 Million Americans
articles.snippet: Sine Health (formerly Nordic Kinetics) received FDA 510(k) clearance on November 15, 2026 for its Sine smartphone-based essential tremor monitoring system, the first FDA-cleared way to track essential tremor passively using only a patient's own smartphone sensors. The app runs in the background continuously between clinic visits, addressing a condition affecting approximately 7 million Americans who are frequently under-optimized on medication due to reliance on brief in-office observations.
articles.result: First smartphone-only FDA-cleared tremor monitor; passive continuous tracking validated

articles.title: BURL Concepts FOQUS™ Ultrasound Receives FDA Clearance; Scans Entire Brain for Stroke-Risk PFO in 40 Seconds
articles.snippet: BURL Concepts received FDA 510(k) clearance on November 19, 2026 for its FOQUS automated transcranial ultrasound system, which screens the entire brain for embolic signals in 40 seconds without requiring a specialist operator. Prior human-use data from 30 patients in the Netherlands and UK successfully identified PFOs, and with 40–50% of cryptogenic stroke patients estimated to have a PFO, the device is positioned to expand stroke-prevention screening into outpatient and physician-office settings.
articles.result: Whole-brain PFO screen in 40 sec; 30-patient EU validation successful

articles.title: Medidata AI-in-Trials Report: Early Adopters Report 72.9% Improvement in Trial Timelines, 67.5% Fewer Protocol Deviations
articles.snippet: Medidata's second annual State of AI in Clinical Trials 2026 report found that organizations with 18+ months of AI implementation experience reported trial timeline improvements in 72.9% of cases and protocol deviation reductions in 67.5% of cases, significantly outpacing the broader industry. With 92% of respondents increasing AI investment and 86.5% already seeing measurable improvements in high-volume rules-based workflows, the report signals a decisive shift from AI experimentation to operational deployment.
articles.result: 72.9% timeline improvement and 67.5% fewer deviations among experienced AI adopters

articles.title: AI-INFOCARE RCT: AI Pre-Consultation Summaries Cut Neurosurgery Outpatient Visit Length, Improve Patient-Rated Communication
articles.source: LQ Ventures Healthcare AI Strategic Roundup
articles.snippet: The AI-INFOCARE randomized controlled trial, covering 300 neurosurgical outpatients, found that quality-checked AI-generated summaries provided before consultations produced shorter consultation times and better patient-rated communication quality compared to standard workflow. The study adds to a growing body of RCT evidence that pre-consultation AI tools can deliver measurable workflow and experience improvements in specialist outpatient settings.
articles.result: Shorter consultations and improved patient communication scores in 300-patient RCT

articles.title: Digital Health Interventions After Orthopaedic Surgery: Systematic Review Confirms Robot-Assisted Rehab Improves Mobility vs. Conventional Care
articles.snippet: A November 2026 systematic review published in PMC covering digital health interventions following lower-extremity orthopaedic surgery found that robot-assisted rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty (TKA) was associated with higher Hospital for Special Surgery scores, improved Berg Balance Scale scores, shorter sit-to-stand times, and longer 6-minute walk test distances compared with conventional rehabilitation. The review synthesized evidence across multiple study designs, reinforcing robot-assisted rehab as superior to standard post-surgical recovery protocols.
articles.result: Robot rehab post-TKA: higher HSS scores, shorter sit-to-stand, longer 6MWT vs. conventional
